# accordion-group API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Related optional details composed as Fluent disclosures inside a native Card.

## AccordionGroup

Group native disclosures in a medium Fluent Card with an optional outside header.
Fluent owns expansion, disabled behavior and motion; no SPFx provider is required.
Closed descendants remain mounted and inert by default; unmountOnClose resets them after exit.
Strings remain literal. All text slots inherit toolkit presets; JSX phrasing children
retain their props and explicit styling. Trigger content must contain no interactive descendants.
Supply nonempty title or description content to name the trigger; native item aria-label
labels the item div and does not name its button. Before programmatic closure,
consumers move focus from panel content when necessary. Root titles use the headingLevel wrapper,
including JSX; avoid nested headings. Native Card padding is the single lateral inset.

### Imports

```ts
import { AccordionGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { AccordionGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import { AccordionGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/accordion-group';
```

### Use when

- Several related disclosure panels need Fluent expansion with retained child state.

### Avoid when

- Use SettingsGroup when fields should remain continuously visible.

### Examples

#### Compose retained preference disclosures

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { AccordionGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

<AccordionGroup title="Preferences" defaultOpenItems={['profile']}>
  <AccordionGroup.Item value="profile" title="Profile">
    Details
  </AccordionGroup.Item>
</AccordionGroup>;
```

## AccordionGroupItemProps

One composable disclosure; caller controls retain identity, labels and state.
Named span slots accept shorthand, native props and render callbacks; refs point inside the trigger.
Requires an `AccordionGroup` ancestor. The heading, button and panel associations
remain owned by the disclosure; item native attributes/ref target its outer div.
Do not place interactive links, controls or block markup in trigger content.

### Imports (4)

```ts
import type { AccordionGroupItemProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { AccordionGroupItemProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { AccordionGroupItemProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/accordion-group';
```

### Examples (5)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { AccordionGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<AccordionGroup><AccordionGroup.Item value="profile" title="Profile">Content</AccordionGroup.Item></AccordionGroup>
```

### Type (2)

```ts
interface AccordionGroupItemProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title" | "dangerouslySetInnerHTML">
```

## AccordionGroupProps

Native div group attributes, optional header and Fluent-owned expansion. Uses the
host Fluent theme/renderer with no SPFx provider; application controls own form state.
Strings stay literal. Text wrappers apply toolkit presets; JSX children retain their props.
Named props accept shorthand, fixed-tag native props or children render callbacks.
Objects request inner containers; refs identify those containers, not owned headings or triggers.
Callbacks receive the fixed tag/composed props during rendering and must forward the props.
Empty static descriptions do not add accessible associations; raw HTML is unsupported.

### Imports (5)

```ts
import type { AccordionGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { AccordionGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls';
import type { AccordionGroupProps } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/controls/accordion-group';
```

### Examples (6)

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { AccordionGroup } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
<AccordionGroup title="Preferences"><AccordionGroup.Item value="profile" title="Profile">Content</AccordionGroup.Item></AccordionGroup>
```

### Type (3)

```ts
interface AccordionGroupProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title" | "onToggle" | "dangerouslySetInnerHTML">
```

| Member | Type | Requirement | Default | Description |

| `AccordionGroupProps.action` | `ContentSlot<"div">` | Optional | — | Optional inner div slot for caller-owned header actions.<br>When omitted, this action region is absent. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.appearance` | `"filled" \| "alternate" \| "outline" \| undefined` | Optional | 'filled' | Native body Card appearance; when omitted, defaults to `filled`.<br>`alternate` uses Fluent's `filled-alternative` surface; `outline` uses its outlined surface.<br>Appearance changes preserve mounted controls and their state. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.children` | `ReactNode` | Optional | — | Caller-owned compound items or custom content, rendered in declared order.<br>When omitted, no child content is added. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.collapsible` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | true | Permit the last open panel to close. when omitted, defaults to true. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.dangerouslySetInnerHTML` | `never` | Forbidden | — | Raw HTML is unsupported; children and content props are the content pathways.<br>Must be omitted or undefined in this branch. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.defaultOpenItems` | `AccordionGroupValue \| AccordionGroupValue[] \| undefined` | Optional | No open items in uncontrolled mode. | Initial uncontrolled open value or values; when omitted, defaults to no open items. Ignored<br>when `openItems` is supplied; later changes do not reset uncontrolled state. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.description` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional inner span slot for supporting phrasing content; wrapper uses caption1 and subtle foreground.<br>When omitted, this description region is absent. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.headingLevel` | `AccordionGroupHeadingLevel \| undefined` | Optional | 2 | Root title wrapper heading level for strings and JSX; when omitted, defaults to 2. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.icon` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional inner span slot for a decorative header icon in a fixed 24px slot; font/SVG children scale without cloning. Hidden from assistive technology.<br>When omitted, this icon region is absent. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.multiple` | `boolean \| undefined` | Optional | false | Permit several open panels. when omitted, defaults to false. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.onToggle` | `AccordionToggleEventHandler<AccordionGroupValue> \| undefined` | Optional | — | Called when Fluent requests expansion/collapse. Receives its mouse/keyboard event<br>and `{ value, openItems }`: the toggled identifier and complete requested open list.<br>Controlled consumers update `openItems`; returned promises are not awaited.<br>When omitted, Fluent still manages uncontrolled expansion, but no consumer toggle notification is delivered. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.openItems` | `AccordionGroupValue \| AccordionGroupValue[] \| undefined` | Optional | — | Controlled open value or values. Update from `onToggle` to accept a requested change;<br>omit this prop for internal Fluent state initialized by `defaultOpenItems`. |
| `AccordionGroupProps.title` | `ContentSlot<"span">` | Optional | — | Optional inner span slot (shorthand, native props or render callback); heading phrasing content; wrapper uses subtitle2 and primary foreground. No nested headings.<br>When omitted, this title region is absent. |
